systems.system: Electronic connection of government institutions under the Digital Tanzania Project
systems.owner: Government of Tanzania, Digital Tanzania Project (World Bank financed, US$150 million, 2021 to 31 October 2026)
systems.tiers: police stations named among the institutions connected, with hospitals, universities, schools, prisons and courts; no count of stations given (project coordinator, September 2026)

note: The project coordinator says police stations have been connected electronically; that is connectivity, an enabling-class entry, and the article names no system in which a station records a report or a case.
